questions.q: What thrust is needed to hold altitude at a 45° bank?
Horizontal acceleration at a bank φ (without drag):
questions.explain: T·sin φ = m·a with T = m·g/cos φ → a = g·tan φ.

questions.q: The radius of a coordinated turn at 15 m/s with a 30° bank:
Why is yaw the “laziest” axis of a multirotor?
options: The firmware limits the yaw rate
A small moment with a large inertia
questions.explain: The difference in CW/CCW reaction torques is small, and all the masses are far from the vertical axis.

questions.q: How does the moment of inertia depend on the distance of a mass from the axis?
options: It does not depend on it
questions.explain: I = Σ m·r²: mass at the ends of the arms is expensive.

questions.q: What is expensive in a climb: acceleration or a steady climb rate?
questions.explain: T = m·(g + a) + D; the drag at 3 m/s for a 7" is ~20 gf versus ~420 gf for a 3 m/s² acceleration.
